Samir: Hey all — heads up: ACME legal is asking for a concise mapping of our retention and audit evidence for an ISO27k auditor next week. They listed: retention policy, where audit logs live and how long, key rotation proof, KMS vs HSM separation, and a short reproducible export that they can validate. Can we assemble artifacts + a 1-page mapping? cc @Leah @Omar :wave:
Leah: I can own the mapping doc. Quick question — is this for Hosted prod only (account 98765) or do we need Dedicated/Private notes too?
Samir: Hosted prod for now (account 98765). They may ask about private later, but start with hosted.
Jules: Also flagged: they previously reported a billing discrepancy in March — they want chain-of-custody for logs used in billing reconciliations. Might need the S3 lifecycle and who accessed the export.
Mike: For hosted: audit logs pipeline summary — events go to CloudWatch Logs, we export daily bundles to s3://redwood-audit-prod/ (365d retention on that bucket for standard evidence; we also have a longer cold store with 7yr lifecycle). KMS: logs-at-rest encrypted with AWS CMK (alias/rdw/audit-prod). HSM-backed keys are used only for Private deployments when customer requests HSM.
Mike: Repro for export (I can run and redact); sample command: `./bin/audit-export --account 98765 --from 2025-01-01 --to 2025-02-01 --output ndjson --redact pii` will generate ndjson with events. Sample output (redacted):
```
{"eventTime":"2025-01-03T14:22:11Z","eventName":"Authenticate","user":"[redacted]","resource":"/v1/generate","status":"200"}
{"eventTime":"2025-01-03T14:22:12Z","eventName":"BillingCharge","user":"[acct-98765]","amount":"[redacted]"}
```
Mike: CloudTrail rotation proof: look for events `ScheduleKeyRotation` / `RotateKey` with the CMK arn in CloudTrail. Example CloudTrail entry (trimmed): `"eventName":"RotateKey","requestParameters":{"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-1234"}`.
Omar: For ISO27k mapping, map controls like A.12.4 (logging and monitoring) -> audit logs pipeline + retention policy, A.10 (cryptographic controls) -> KMS management and rotation records, A.8 (asset inventory) -> account-level mapping. Evidence list we need: 1) retention policy doc (pdf) 2) s3 lifecycle config (xml/json) 3) one redacted audit-export ndjson 4) CloudTrail rotation events for the CMK 5) access logs showing who downloaded the export 6) admin approval tickets for any retention exceptions.
Leah: I'll draft the one-pager mapping with those artifacts attached. Mike — can you produce the redacted export and a zip with the S3 lifecycle policy + a screenshot or the `aws s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration` output? Also we need the exact CMK ARN and last rotation timestamp.
Mike: On it. ETA ~20m. I'll include the command I ran and the sha256 of the zip for chain-of-custody. Command I will run: `./bin/audit-export --account 98765 --since 2025-01-01 --format ndjson | ./bin/redact --rules compliance/redact-rules.yml > acme-audit-2025-jan.ndjson` then `aws s3 cp acme-audit-2025-jan.ndjson s3://redwood-evidence/98765/ --acl bucket-owner-full-control`
Jules: I'll open a legal ticket for the cover letter and confirm DPA status. Also add a short statement about billing reconciliation process (who approves and who signs off).
Samir: Great — also include a short note about retention exceptions (we had one customer data retention exception in 2024 Q4 with ticket #T-4421) — include that in the mapping under "exceptions".
deploy-bot: Audit export job completed: job_id=ae-20250301-1722, status=SUCCESS, objects=1, size=4.3MB :white_check_mark:
Mike: Upload done, bucket path: s3://redwood-evidence/98765/acme-audit-2025-01.ndjson (redacted). CMK arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-1234-ef56. Last rotation: 2024-11-12T03:15:22Z. S3 lifecycle config attached (snippet): `{"Rules":[{"ID":"audit-retain","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":365}}]}`
Leah: I have the draft mapping and attachments. I'll ping legal for the DPA. Planning to export the mapping as `ACME_ISO27k_Mapping_20250301.pdf` and drop in the evidence bucket.
Omar: Once Leah posts the mapping, I will annotate the control references and export a compliance matrix (spreadsheet) for the auditor. Also recommend adding a short note about split of responsibilities: Redwood manages hosted key lifecycle; customer-managed keys/HSM only for Private.
Samir: Perfect. Thanks team. If the auditor asks for live repro, we should be ready to run the export in a controlled window and provide a signed delivery proof. I'll schedule a call with ACME for Friday. :calendar:
